question: If ΔABC is similar to ΔDEF such that 2AB = DE and BC = 8 cm, then EF is equal to:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When two triangles are similar, the ratio of their corresponding sides is equal.

Given ΔABC ~ ΔDEF and 2AB = DE ⇒ DE/AB = 2.

The scale factor from ΔABC to ΔDEF is 2.

∴ EF = 2 × BC = 2 × 8 = 16 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 16 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

ΔABC ~ ΔDEF

2AB = DE ⇒ AB/DE = 1/2

BC = 8 cm

**Formula Used:**

If two triangles are similar, the ratio of their corresponding sides is equal:

AB/DE = BC/EF = AC/DF

**Calculations:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Similarity of Triangles

Two triangles are similar if their corresponding angles are equal and corresponding sides are proportional. ΔABC ~ ΔDEF ⇒ AB/DE = BC/EF = AC/DF.

Area of Similar Triangles

The ratio of the areas of two similar triangles is equal to the square of the ratio of their corresponding sides: Area(ΔABC) / Area(ΔDEF) = (AB/DE)².

Perimeter of Similar Triangles

The ratio of the perimeters of two similar triangles is equal to the ratio of their corresponding sides: Perimeter(ΔABC) / Perimeter(ΔDEF) = AB/DE.
